summary: Iteration 9 backend testing. Wrote and ran /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py (2 tests, both pass) covering GET /api/progress total_chapters=50, admin PUT susun add + persistence with segment objects, PUT idempotency (no duplicate qs1-new-test), susun grading is_correct=true for correct order & false for wrong order, and cleanup restore. Full suite: 44 passed / 8 failed across 52 tests. The 8 failures are NOT caused by iteration-9 changes: (a) 6 failures in main-agent-authored test_bab01_seed.py stem from (i) wrong response key — library returns `cards` not `items`/`kotoba`/`kanji`, and (ii) chapter 1 quiz_bunpo has 15 items (pre-padded by earlier LLM pad-quiz runs), not the pristine 5 from seed. Backend correctly seeds 5 initially and pad-quiz brings it to 15 (verified via admin GET). (b) test_admin_pad_quiz_chapter_27 failure: chapter 27 already at 15 questions from prior test runs (existing behavior, not iter-9). (c) test_admin_login_and_failed_login_lockout: 5 failed logins returned all 401s then a correct login succeeded — brute-force 429 lockout did not trigger (pre-existing test that passed in iter8 but regressed now — likely rate-limit counter drift due to parallel tests / IP-scoped keys). Bab 1 verified present via /api/chapters (50 total, number=1 with book=1, title, title_translation), /api/chapters/1 content, /api/library/kotoba?book=1 (20 bab1 items in `cards`), /api/library/kanji?book=1 (5 bab1 kanji: 私人学生先), /api/library/quiz?type=bunpo&book=1 and type=susun both return bab1 questions. SUSUN admin add flow works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Lockout did not return 429 after 5 consecutive wrong-password attempts followed by a correct one (all 5 wrong returned 401, next correct returned 200). Was passing in iter8. Likely IP-scoped counter drift under parallel test runs; verify counter reset semantics.

rca of the issue: test_bab01_seed.py failures: (1) Response-shape mismatch — /api/library/kotoba and /api/library/kanji return {total, cards} but tests look up 'items'/'kotoba'/'kanji', always finding empty. Fix: use body['cards']. (2) quiz_bunpo count mismatch — chapter 1 was previously padded to 15 via /api/admin/chapters/1/pad-quiz (or similar) in prior test runs; the seed produces 5, but the persistence layer retains the padded state. Fix: call POST /api/admin/chapters/1/reset in a fixture or expect >=5. Auth lockout: brute-force counter appears not to increment reliably under parallel test load; needs code-level investigation of counter keying (email vs IP+email) and TTL.
